questions.stem: What should patients and carers be taught after a single-shot peripheral nerve block?
questions.answer: Protect the numb limb until the block wears off

questions.stem: After a single-shot peripheral nerve block, when should regular analgesia be advised?
options: Only once the patient asks for it
Only when the block has fully resolved

questions.stem: What should be checked at follow-up after a single-shot peripheral nerve block?
questions.answer: That the block has fully resolved
